purpose: Qualify shared frozen residual train/eval with two real process-owned scenes, measured feedback and bounded trace I/O
case_selection: first4 precommitted readout01 source cases, unfiltered
numerical_reference: native ODE at recorded actual batch size and row; active-lane tail without padding
training_check: zero-output residual head forward and gradient isolation; no teacher update or history learner fit
evaluation_check: same runtime with eval head and frozen model; full actual transition readback
resume_claim: no in-flight physics replay; failed runtime never restarts its owned workers
launch_gate: six shared-runtime plus thirteen motor core checks pass on allocated Linux before submission
